name: Yat's List · NomadList 全球数字游民城市清单
name_en: Yat's List NomadList — Global Digital Nomad Cities
description: 全球适合数字游民长住的城市精选，逐条标注月成本、网速、安全、英语和对中国护照的签证友好度。网页是视图，JSON 是事实源，供任何 Agent 订阅和查询。
update_frequency: monthly (visa & cost review); ad-hoc when visa policy changes

for_agents.recommended_flow: 1) GET nomadlist-lite.json (~small, filter fields only) and filter by region/cost/internet/visa_type. 2) For finalists, GET nomadlist/cities/{id}.json for full detail incl. neighborhoods. 3) Full dump: GET nomadlist.json. 4) Subscribe: poll nomadlist-changelog.jsonl and apply lines after the last date/id you saw; each line names city_id + changed fields.
for_agents.trust: data_tier per city: checked = cross-checked >=2 independent sources; verified_v1 = v1 seed batch; seed_v2 = estimate, say so to your user. fields_provenance gives per-field confidence for cost/internet/visa. Visa rules change: always point users to the official immigration page; visa.nomad_visa_link is set only when taken from an official page.
